criteria.text: The participant has a histologically or cytologically confirmed advanced solid tumor that is positive for EGFR and has progressed despite standard therapy or for whom no standard therapy exists.

source.text: Patients with histologically or cytologically confirmed advanced solid tumor that is positive for EGFR and has progressed despite standard therapy or for whom no standard therapy exists.

criteria.text: Archival tumor tissue is available for assessment of EGFR status via FDA-approved EGFR assay.

source.text: Patients are required to have archival tumor tissue available for assessment of EGFR status via FDA-approved EGFR assay .

criteria.text: The participant is ≥ 18 years old.

source.text: Age ≥ 18 years.

criteria.text: The participant has at least 1 measurable lesion as defined by RECIST v1.1.

source.text: Patients must have at least 1 measurable lesion as defined by RECIST v1.1.

criteria.text: The participant has an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status of 0 or 1.

source.text: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status of 0 or 1.

criteria.text: The participant has a life expectancy ≥ 12 weeks.

source.text: Life expectancy ≥ 12 weeks.

criteria.text: Baseline organ function and laboratory data meet the following criteria: ANC ≥ 1500 cells/mm3, Platelet count ≥ 75 000 cells/mm3, Hemoglobin ≥ 8.0 g/dL, Prothrombin time ≤ 1.5× ULN, Activated partial thromboplastin time ≤ 1.5× ULN, Serum creatinine ≤ 1.5× ULN, estimated glomerular filtration rate ≥ 60 mL/min (Cockcroft-Gault formula), Serum total bilirubin ≤ 1.5 mg/dL, AST and ALT ≤ 3.0× ULN (if metastases are present, ≤ 5.0× ULN).

source.text:
Baseline organ function and laboratory data meet the following criteria:

  1. Bone marrow： ANC ≥ 1500 cells/mm3； Platelet count ≥ 75 000 cells/mm3； Hemoglobin ≥ 8.0 g/dL.
  2. Coagulation： Prothrombin time ≤ 1.5× ULN； Activated partial thromboplastin time ≤ 1.5× ULN；
  3. Renal function： Serum creatinine ≤ 1.5× ULN ； estimated glomerular filtration rate≥ 60 mL/min (Cockcroft-Gault formula).
  4. Hepatic function： Serum total bilirubin ≤ 1.5 mg/dL； AST and ALT ≤ 3.0× ULN (if metastases are present, ≤ 5.0× ULN).

criteria.text: Females are not pregnant or lactating, and females of childbearing potential and males agree to use contraception.

source.text: Females will not be pregnant or lactating, and females of childbearing potential and males will agree to use contraception.

criteria.text: The participant provides written informed consent prior to any study procedures.

source.text: Patients must provide written informed consent prior to any study procedures.

criteria.text: The participant has a history of another primary cancer ≤ 3 years, with the exception of completely resected nonmelanoma skin cancer or carcinoma in situ of uterine cervix.

source.text: History of another primary cancer ≤ 3 years, with the exception of completely resected nonmelanoma skin cancer or carcinoma in situ of uterine cervix.

criteria.text: The participant has active or symptomatic CNS metastases, or treated CNS metastases that have not been stable for ≥ 4 weeks or require treatment with steroids or anticonvulsants.

source.text: Active or symptomatic CNS metastases. Patients with treated CNS metastases that have been stable for ≥ 4 weeks and do not require treatment with steroids or anticonvulsants may be enrolled at the discretion of the Investigator.

criteria.text: The participant tests positive for hepatitis C virus, hepatitis B virus, or human immunodeficiency virus infection.

source.text: Tests positive for hepatitis C virus, hepatitis B virus, or human immunodeficiency virus infection.

criteria.text: The participant has active, clinically significant infections.

source.text: Active, clinically significant infections.

criteria.text: The participant has clinically significant cardiovascular disease, including congestive heart failure (New York Heart Association Class > 2), serious cardiac arrhythmia, myocardial infarction ≤ 6 months, or unstable angina.

source.text:
Clinically significant cardiovascular disease, including any of the following:

  1. Congestive heart failure (New York Heart Association Class \> 2).
  2. Serious cardiac arrhythmia.
  3. Myocardial infarction ≤ 6 months.
  4. Unstable angina.

criteria.text: The participant had a prior clinically significant allergic reaction to chimerized or murine monoclonal antibody therapy.

source.text: Prior clinically significant allergic reaction to chimerized or murine monoclonal antibody therapy.

criteria.text: The participant had prior treatment ≤ 6 months with cetuximab, panitumomab, gefitinib, erlotinib, or other therapy that specifically and directly targets the EGF pathway.

source.text: Prior treatment ≤ 6 months with cetuximab, panitumomab, gefitinb, erlotinib, or other therapy that specifically and directly targets the EGF pathway.

criteria.text: The participant had anticancer therapy or investigational agents for nonmalignant disease ≤ 4 weeks or 5 half-lives, whichever is shorter, prior to Cycle 1 Day 1, with the exception of tamoxifen for patients with a history of operated breast cancer > 3 years and no evidence of disease after surgery.

source.text: Anticancer therapy or investigational agents for nonmalignant disease ≤ 4 weeks or 5 half-lives, whichever is shorter, prior to Cycle 1 Day 1, with the exception of tamoxifen for patients with a history of operated breast cancer \> 3 years and no evidence of disease after surgery.

criteria.text: The participant had major surgery ≤ 4 weeks.

source.text: Major surgery ≤ 4 weeks.

criteria.text: The participant has a clinically significant psychiatric illness, other comorbidity, or laboratory abnormality that, in the opinion of the Investigator, makes it unsafe for the patient to participate in the study or may interfere with study compliance or study results.

source.text: Clinically significant psychiatric illness, other comorbidity, or laboratory abnormality that, in the opinion of the Investigator, makes it unsafe for the patient to participate in the study or may interfere with study compliance or study results.

criteria.text: The participant has other unspecified reasons that, in the opinion of the Investigator, make the patient unsuitable for enrollment.

source.text: Other unspecified reasons that, in the opinion of the Investigator, make the patient unsuitable for enrollment.
